minutes.headline: Planning Board, with three members present, approved a de minimis site plan change letting 88 Mass Ave's retail space be a liquor store.
minutes.summary: The vice chair ran a short meeting with only three members. The board tabled the de minimis request, then took it up again when the applicant arrived and approved it. They also approved the July 24 minutes, heard committee reports and discussed the 525 Chase Road decision. Master plan, solar, driveways and aquifer items were deferred until the chair and land use director return.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a de minimis site plan change at 88 Mass Avenue, with three ayes, after the applicant joined the meeting.
The vice chair had tabled the same 88 Mass Avenue request twice earlier, because the land use director was absent and the board lacked information.
The applicant told the board about the property's history, the zoning board approval and a 22-year lease, and asked that the change not be delayed.
The 525 Chase Road decision was not signed at the meeting; members will sign it at the planning office later in the week.
The master plan steering committee, solar bylaw, driveways and entrances, and aquifer protection bylaw were deferred to a meeting with the chair and land use director.

why_it_matters: The approval allows the retail space at 88 Mass Avenue to be used as a liquor store, a change to a site plan that was made with only three board members present.
The solar, driveway and aquifer protection bylaw discussions were pushed back, so rules that could affect residents' property and water protection did not advance at this meeting.
watch_next: Signing of the 525 Chase Road decision at the planning office later in the week.
The meeting with the chair and land use director that will take up the deferred bylaw and master plan items.
